text: Rin's dad had a fall on Saturday and broke his wrist. He's in a cast for six weeks, and she's driving over to help most evenings after work. Her brother Rory lives in Glasgow so can't do much day to day, which she's a bit sore about. Her dad hates being fussed over, apparently, and keeps trying to mow the lawn one-handed.
Rory is obsessed with Warhammer at the moment. He's painting a whole Space Marine army and wants to enter a local tournament sometime next month.
Need to text Divya on Thursday to see how her mum's scan went. It's at 10am and she's quite anxious about it.

Cem says his son Emre has tonsillitis again, third time this year. They're seeing the ENT consultant on May 14 about getting them out. Cem's wife has had to take loads of unpaid leave and they're both shattered from the broken nights. Emre is only six and properly scared of the idea of an operation, so they're reading him books about hospitals.
Abdi supports Arsenal and has done since he was a kid. Season ticket holder, sits in the North Bank with his brother Yusuf.
Lovely catch-up with Niamh. Her daughter starts primary school in early September and Niamh is already dreading the first morning. Her husband Colm is taking the week off to help settle her in.

Gustavo's knee surgery got moved to June 3rd. He's been off running for months and is going a bit stir crazy. His wife Ana says he's been reorganising the garage at midnight. He's hoping to be back on the bike by the end of the summer and has already booked a sportive in early October, which seems optimistic. I should check in with him the week after the op.
Eilidh knits constantly. She's making a jumper for her niece and said she'd love some decent merino yarn, which might be a good birthday idea for later in the year.
Buy milk, return the library books, book the car in for its MOT sometime next week.
Mila called. Her brother Leon has been signed off work with stress and is staying with her for a while. Don't forget to check in with her at the end of the week.
Ellie and her partner Lukas are celebrating ten years together on 7/22. They're thinking about a weekend in the Lake District.
Olivia's mum has been diagnosed with type 2 diabetes. Olivia is overhauling the whole family's diet and finding it a lot.

Shreya plays bass in a covers band called The Late Shift. Their next gig is at the Crown on Friday night and she's nervous because they've added three new songs, including a Fleetwood Mac one with a tricky bassline. Her husband Arjun is filming it for their socials. Text her good luck on Friday afternoon, and try to actually go this time.
Liam's little boy Jack had chickenpox last week. All recovered now and back at nursery.
Should message Yusuf over the weekend and ask how his dad is getting on after the hip replacement.
Lola reads a ridiculous amount, mostly crime fiction. She's working through every Tana French book and is on the last one.
Anders is going to Norway over the summer to see his grandmother, who turns 90 on August 9th. The whole family is flying in from all over.
Dong mentioned his wife Mei is pregnant, due early March. First baby for both of them. He looked thrilled and terrified at the same time.
Bethany's dog Biscuit had surgery on his leg yesterday. She's exhausted from sleeping on the floor next to his crate.
Delroy coaches his daughter's under-11 football team on Saturday mornings. They've reached the county cup final, which is on April 26.
Anika told me her father is going back into hospital at the end of the month for more tests. She doesn't want to talk about it much, so I should just keep things light and maybe send her something.
Oliver is learning the cello at 42. Lessons every Tuesday, and he's got his Grade 1 exam on 11/18. He keeps saying he'll fail.
Karim and his wife Leila have had to cancel their trip to Morocco because her mum is unwell. They were meant to fly on May 2.
Thomas has gone vegan since we last met. Also gave up drinking. He seems genuinely happier.
Remind me to ring Colm on Monday. His brother Cathal has his chemo review that afternoon and Colm wants someone to talk to after.
Jin builds mechanical keyboards. Spent about twenty minutes explaining switches to me. He's after a particular set of Japanese keycaps, which would make a good Christmas present.
Ifeoma's son Tobi broke his arm at trampolining. He's fine, mostly annoyed that he can't play Fortnite properly with a cast on.
Karan is moving to Leeds sometime in the spring for a new job at a games studio. His partner Priya is staying in Bristol until her contract ends in June.
Manon's grandad passed away on Sunday. The funeral is sometime next week in Lyon and she's flying out on Wednesday. Must send flowers to her flat before she leaves.
Quick note: Rin Suzuki from the pottery class is selling some of her bowls at the Christmas market on December 12. I said I'd go along.

Rory's mum, Mrs Murphy, has been in and out of hospital with her heart. Rory is the only one of the siblings nearby, so he's carrying most of it. He sounded worn out on the phone. I should offer to cover his shift on the 9th so he can go to her cardiology appointment.
Cem plays chess online every night and has just hit 1800 on Lichess. He wants to play in a proper over-the-board tournament over the summer.
Divya's daughter got into the county youth orchestra! Violin. First rehearsal is on 9/14 and Divya is beside herself.
Abdi has a dodgy back again. Physio twice a week and no five-a-side until at least the end of the month.
Talked to Niamh's husband, Colm, about the boat he's restoring. Thirty-year-old wooden sailing dinghy, wants it on the water by late June.
Need to pick up a birthday card for Gustavo's wife Ana. Her birthday is on the 30th and he's planning a surprise dinner on the Saturday after.

Eilidh's mum fell and fractured her hip. Surgery went well on Tuesday, but she'll be in hospital for at least another week. Eilidh is going back and forth from Inverness. Text her tomorrow to see how she's holding up.
Gym, then laundry. Dentist on 3/11 at 9:15.
Mila and Leon have finally set a date for the housewarming: Saturday the 15th, from 7pm. They want everyone to bring a board game.
Ellie said Lukas has been getting migraines almost every day. He's got a neurology referral sometime in the next few weeks, but the wait is awful.

Leon is training for his first marathon, Chicago on October 11. Running about 60k a week. He's worried his calf will flare up again, because it went at 30k in the half last spring. He's seeing a sports physio on 9/2 for a gait analysis, and his girlfriend Anika is going out to Chicago with him to cheer. He's raising money for the stroke charity because of his grandad.
Olivia mentioned her son Max is struggling at uni. Homesick, not really making friends. She's thinking of driving up to see him at half term.
Shreya's husband Arjun got his promotion at the hospital. Head of radiology from the start of next month.
Don't forget to ask Liam how his mum's cataract operation went. It was on Friday.
Lola's cat Pickle went missing on Tuesday and came back this morning, very pleased with himself. Lola was in bits for three days.
Anders has gone completely down the sourdough rabbit hole. He's got a starter called Gerald and bakes every Sunday.

Called Dong back. Mei's twenty-week scan is on June 8, and his parents are flying over from Shanghai the week after. He's sorting out the spare room for them. Ask him how the scan went when I see him at football.

Bethany is training as a nurse and has her final placement on the children's ward from mid-January. Her sister Lily is also a nurse, at the same hospital, on nights. Bethany is a bit nervous about the placement because her last mentor was awful, but she loves paediatrics and wants to specialise. Their mum is so proud she tells literally everyone.
Delroy has gout, apparently. He's not allowed red meat or beer, which he finds outrageous.

Anika's wedding is off. She and Ravi split up at the start of the month. She's staying with her parents for now and says she's okay, but she clearly isn't. I'll take her out for lunch sometime next week, just the two of us, and I won't bring it up unless she does.
Oliver's daughter Isla has her first piano recital on May 21st. He asked if I'd come and I said yes.
Karim got the all clear after his biopsy! Huge relief. He's celebrating with a family dinner on Friday.
Thomas collects vinyl, mostly 70s soul and jazz. He's been after an original pressing of What's Going On for years. Worth remembering.
Message Jin about the Overwatch tournament. He's in a team with his cousins and they play the semi-final on 12/5.
Ifeoma and her husband Chidi are renewing their vows in Lagos over Easter. Their twins will be page boys.
Karan has had Covid for nearly two weeks and still can't taste anything. He's working from home until at least the 20th.

Long chat with Manon after the funeral. She's back in London now but her grandmother is on her own in Lyon and not coping well. Manon is thinking about going back for a month over the summer, possibly with her brother Hugo. She also mentioned her cat Mochi needs a sitter if she goes. Should offer, and check in with her sometime next week.
Nothing much to note. Coffee with Rory, mostly moaned about the weather.
Cem's daughter Defne passed her driving test on the second try! He's terrified about insurance prices now.

Divya wants to start climbing. Her brother Rahul goes to the wall in town on Wednesdays, so she's going to try a taster session with him on 4/9. Remind me to text her that evening to see if she survived.
